gloss: to save up regularly; to accumulate (money); to set aside

definitions.gloss: to save up regularly; to accumulate money; to set aside periodically
definitions.explanation: To regularly put aside money over time, building up a sum through periodic contributions. Used for savings plans, investment accounts, and any systematic accumulation of funds.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}1{万円|まんえん}ずつ{積|つ}み{立|た}てている。
examples.english: I'm setting aside 10,000 yen each month.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}のためにコツコツ{積|つ}み{立|た}てる。
examples.english: To steadily save up for the future.

examples.japanese: {投資信託|とうししんたく}で{毎月|まいつき}{少額|しょうがく}から{積|つ}み{立|た}てることができる。
examples.english: You can save up from a small amount each month through investment trusts.

notes:
A financial term meaning to regularly set aside money over time. This concept is central to Japanese personal finance, where {積|つ}み{立|た}て (the noun form) is a fundamental savings and investment strategy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毎月|まいつき}{積|つ}み{立|た}てる: to save up monthly
- コツコツ{積|つ}み{立|た}てる: to save up steadily
- {少額|しょうがく}から{積|つ}み{立|た}てる: to start saving from a small amount

RELATED FINANCIAL TERMS:
- {積|つ}み{立|た}て: regular savings/investment (noun form)
- {積立|つみたて}NISA: tax-free investment savings plan (a popular Japanese program)
- {積立|つみたて}{預金|よきん}: installment savings
- {定期|ていき}{預金|よきん}: time deposit, fixed-term savings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貯|た}める: to save (money) — more general; doesn't imply regular periodic contributions
- {蓄|たくわ}える: to accumulate, to store up — more literary and broader (can include food, knowledge)
